notes: Conforms to the capitalized-plural-label rule ('the Keepers' = a Name-only individual, no GroupOf and no invented per-member kind, hence correctly no distribution rule for the warding), keeps the phrasal verb whole as ward_back with no genus and no single-word synonym, and takes Theme for the displaced wraith. The bare-plural instrument gets a group witness and the participial modifier 'ground' distributes to the members by rule rather than riding the group symbol, exactly as the descriptive-modifier-on-a-plural rule requires.
